title: Vector2.UP and friends
prompt: Return the velocity of something moving straight up at the given speed. Godot has ready-made direction vectors such as Vector2.UP, and remember that up means a negative y on screen.
starter:
func solve(speed: float) -> Vector2:
	return Vector2.ZERO
hint: A direction of length 1 times a speed gives a velocity.
solution:
func solve(speed: float) -> Vector2:
	return Vector2.UP * speed
